title: There's a hidden iPhone keyboard with lots of adorable smiley faces - here's how to turn it on (AAPL)
text: There's a hidden iPhone keyboard with lots of adorable smiley faces — here's how to turn it on (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Oct 28, 2018, 10:00 am 29 pts There may be over 2,800 emoji available on your phone, but some occasions deserve an old-school smiley face — and there's a keyboard with a ton of smileys already installed on your iPhone. These smileys are hidden inside the Japanese keyboard, which is installed by default on all iPhones. Once you…
